harness_sources.http_side.py:
"""HTTP side of the fetch-mode benchmark: discovery, ECDEV robots decisions, plain HTTP captures.

python -I http_side.py <out dir> <ecdev helper binary>
Public sites built for scraping practice only; every URL is checked with ECDEV's robots evaluator
(agent ECDEV) before it is fetched; at least 2 s (or the robots crawl delay) between requests to
one host; ECDEV's user agent; no cookies, no login, nothing but GET.
"""
import json, pathlib, re, subprocess, sys, time, urllib.parse
import requests
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); helper = sys.argv[2]; out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
UA = "ECDEV/0.1 (+read-only research)"
S = requests.Session(); S.headers["User-Agent"] = UA
SEEDS = {
    "books.toscrape.com": ("https://books.toscrape.com/", r'href="(catalogue/(?!category/)[^"]+/index\.html)"'),
    "scrapeme.live": ("https://scrapeme.live/shop/", r'href="(https://scrapeme\.live/shop/[^"/]+/)"'),
    "webscraper.io-static": ("https://webscraper.io/test-sites/e-commerce/static/computers/laptops", r'href="(/test-sites/e-commerce/static/product/\d+)"'),
}
robots_cache, last = {}, {}
def robots(url):
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).netloc
    if host not in robots_cache:
        r = S.get(f"https://{host}/robots.txt", timeout=20)
        path = out / f"robots-{host}.txt"
        if r.status_code == 200: path.write_text(r.text)
        robots_cache[host] = (path if r.status_code == 200 else None, r.status_code)
        last[host] = time.time()
    path, status = robots_cache[host]
    d = json.loads(subprocess.check_output([helper, "robots", str(path) if path else "-", url]))
    if status not in (200, 404): d["allowed"] = False
    return d
def get(url):
    d = robots(url)
    if not d["allowed"]: return None, d
    host = urllib.parse.urlsplit(url).netloc
    wait = max(2.0, d["crawl_delay"] or 0) - (time.time() - last.get(host, 0))
    if wait > 0: time.sleep(wait)
    r = S.get(url, timeout=30, allow_redirects=True); last[host] = time.time()
    return r, d
targets = []
for site, (seed, pattern) in SEEDS.items():
    r, d = get(seed)
    targets.append({"site": site, "kind": "listing", "url": seed})
    links = []
    for m in re.findall(pattern, r.text):
        u = urllib.parse.urljoin(seed, m)
        if u not in links: links.append(u)
    targets += [{"site": site, "kind": "product", "url": u} for u in links[:8]]
    if site == "webscraper.io-static":
        # The same catalogue served by the site's JavaScript-loaded variant.
        targets.append({"site": "webscraper.io-ajax", "kind": "listing", "url": seed.replace("/static/", "/ajax/")})
        targets += [{"site": "webscraper.io-ajax", "kind": "product", "url": u.replace("/static/", "/ajax/")} for u in links[:8]]
for i, t in enumerate(targets):
    r, d = get(t["url"])
    t["robots"] = d
    if r is None:
        t["http"] = {"status": "ROBOTS_DENIED"}; continue
    f = out / f"http-{i:03d}.html"; f.write_bytes(r.content)
    t["http"] = {"status": r.status_code, "content_type": r.headers.get("content-type", ""), "final_url": r.url, "file": f.name, "bytes": len(r.content)}
    t["id"] = i
(out / "targets.json").write_text(json.dumps(targets, indent=1))
print(len(targets), "targets", sum(1 for t in targets if t.get("http", {}).get("status") == 200), "fetched")
harness_sources.compare.py:
"""Compares ECDEV's extraction of the plain HTTP and the rendered capture of each URL.

python -I compare.py <out dir> <ecdev helper binary> <record.json>
Agreement is on the evidence ECDEV keeps: per product (keyed by title, else sku) the price in
minor units, currency and availability. Classes: SAME, RENDER_ADDS_PRODUCTS, HTTP_ADDS_PRODUCTS,
VALUES_DIFFER, NEITHER (no product evidence either way).
"""
import collections, hashlib, json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
out = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); helper = sys.argv[2]; record = pathlib.Path(sys.argv[3])
targets = json.loads((out / "targets.json").read_text())
def extract(file, ct, url):
    return json.loads(subprocess.check_output([helper, "extract", str(out / file), ct or "text/html", url]))
def evidence(x):
    if not x.get("ok"): return {}
    return {str(p.get("title") or p.get("sku")): (p.get("price_minor"), p.get("currency"), p.get("availability")) for p in x["products"]}
rows = []
for t in targets:
    if "file" not in t.get("http", {}) or "file" not in t.get("render", {}): continue
    h = extract(t["http"]["file"], t["http"]["content_type"], t["http"]["final_url"])
    r = extract(t["render"]["file"], "text/html; charset=utf-8", t["render"]["final_url"])
    eh, er = evidence(h), evidence(r)
    if not eh and not er: cls = "NEITHER"
    elif eh == er: cls = "SAME"
    elif set(er) > set(eh) and all(er[k] == v for k, v in eh.items()): cls = "RENDER_ADDS_PRODUCTS"
    elif set(eh) > set(er) and all(eh[k] == v for k, v in er.items()): cls = "HTTP_ADDS_PRODUCTS"
    else: cls = "VALUES_DIFFER"
    fields = lambda e: {"with_price": sum(v[0] is not None for v in e.values()), "with_availability": sum(v[2] is not None for v in e.values())}
    rows.append({"site": t["site"], "kind": t["kind"], "url": t["url"], "class": cls,
                 "http": {"products": len(eh), **fields(eh), "bytes": t["http"]["bytes"]},
                 "rendered": {"products": len(er), **fields(er), "bytes": t["render"]["bytes"], "ms": t["render"]["ms"]},
                 "differences": {k: {"http": eh.get(k), "rendered": er.get(k)} for k in sorted(set(eh) | set(er)) if eh.get(k) != er.get(k)}})
summary = {}
for site in sorted({r["site"] for r in rows}):
    rs = [r for r in rows if r["site"] == site]
    summary[site] = {"pages": len(rs), "classes": dict(collections.Counter(r["class"] for r in rs)),
                     "products_http": sum(r["http"]["products"] for r in rs), "products_rendered": sum(r["rendered"]["products"] for r in rs),
                     "median_render_ms": sorted(r["rendered"]["ms"] for r in rs)[len(rs) // 2]}
here = pathlib.Path(__file__).parent
record.write_text(json.dumps({
    "benchmark": "changedetection.fetcher-selection: when does a plain HTTP fetch give ECDEV the same price and stock evidence as a rendered browser?",
    "sites": "public sites built for scraping practice (books.toscrape.com, scrapeme.live, webscraper.io e-commerce test sites, static and ajax variants); every URL allowed by ECDEV's robots evaluator; 2 s minimum per host; ECDEV user agent; GET only",
    "extractor": "ECDEV's own adapter/web document::extract on both captures",
    "renderer": "Chromium (Playwright 1.56.1, chromium-1194) through the session proxy with TLS verification, network-idle wait",
    "evidence_state": "BENCHMARK_MEASUREMENT of fetch modes on practice sites; not evidence about any market",
    "summary": summary, "pages": rows,
    "harness_sources": {n: (here / n).read_text() for n in ["http_side.py", "render_side.mjs", "compare.py"]} | {"ecdev_side/src/main.rs": (here / "ecdev_side/src/main.rs").read_text()},
    "captures_sha256": {f.name: hashlib.sha256(f.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for f in sorted(out.glob("*.html"))}}, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
print(json.dumps(summary, indent=1))
for r in rows:
    if r["class"] != "SAME": print(r["class"], r["url"], json.dumps(r["differences"])[:300])

findings: scrapeme.live (WooCommerce, JSON-LD): the plain HTTP and the rendered capture give identical price, currency and availability on all 7 product pages
webscraper.io static and ajax: both modes yield products with no structured price or availability; the JavaScript-loaded listing gains 6 items only when rendered, none with price evidence
books.toscrape.com: prices and stock appear only as unstructured text, so ECDEV extracts no product in either mode; the limit is the evidence policy, not the fetch mode
Rendering added no price or stock evidence on any page, at a median 1.3 to 2.1 s per page plus a browser

decision.changedetection.fetcher-selection: answered for practice sites: plain HTTP suffices wherever structured product data is served; the question stays open for real retail pages that inject JSON-LD with JavaScript

limits: practice sites only; four hosts; 32 pages; no real retailer sampled
